connector.name: App Store Connect by beautyfree
connector.registryDescription: App Store Connect API as MCP: apps, TestFlight, subscriptions, localizations, reports. JWT auth.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-asc. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the beautyfree account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID
env.description: API Key ID from App Store Connect (Users and Access → Integrations → App Store Connect API)

env.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID
env.description: Issuer ID from App Store Connect

env.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_P8_PATH
env.description: Path to your .p8 private key file (downloaded from App Store Connect)

env.name: APP_STORE_CONNECT_VENDOR_NUMBER
env.description: Vendor number; required for sales and finance reports only
